detect: (?:ops/sec\s+\d+ usecs/op|Compare file sync methods|second per test)
examples:
1 second per test
O_DIRECT supported on this platform for open_datasync and open_sync.

Compare file sync methods using one 8kB write:
(in wal_sync_method preference order, except fdatasync is Linux's default)
        open_datasync                      4449.923 ops/sec     225 usecs/op
        fdatasync                          4607.963 ops/sec     217 usecs/op
        fsync                              4783.996 ops/sec     209 usecs/op
        fsync_writethrough                              n/a
        open_sync                          4731.257 ops/sec     211 usecs/op

Compare file sync methods using two 8kB writes:
(in wal_sync_method preference order, except fdatasync is Linux's default)
        open_datasync                      2361.872 ops/sec     423 usecs/op
        fdatasync                          4452.412 ops/sec     225 usecs/op
        fsync                              4262.135 ops/sec     235 usecs/op
        fsync_writethrough                              n/a
        open_sync                          2235.014 ops/sec     447 usecs/op

Compare open_sync with different write sizes:
(This is designed to compare the cost of writing 16kB in different write
open_sync sizes.)
         1 * 16kB open_sync write          4488.735 ops/sec     223 usecs/op
         2 *  8kB open_sync writes         2466.485 ops/sec     405 usecs/op
         4 *  4kB open_sync writes         1372.415 ops/sec     729 usecs/op
         8 *  2kB open_sync writes          600.571 ops/sec    1665 usecs/op
        16 *  1kB open_sync writes          293.903 ops/sec    3402 usecs/op

Test if fsync on non-write file descriptor is honored:
(If the times are similar, fsync() can sync data written on a different
descriptor.)
        write, fsync, close                5143.727 ops/sec     194 usecs/op
        write, close, fsync                5511.592 ops/sec     181 usecs/op

Non-sync'ed 8kB writes:
        write                           2724209.171 ops/sec       0 usecs/op
